title: Story plan still scans every Item in the duplicate cut and decided ideas
description: Found 2026-11-08 while fixing the story steps' whole-Item scan (AnthusAI/Papyrus#1293). The daily story plan still reads Items without an index in two places: duplicate_cut and labels.decided_ideas. It runs once a day, not per step, but it is still a whole-table read that grows with the Item table. Replace it with indexed reads (the stage indexes or a purpose-built index) and add the call sites to the whole-table ratchet's downward count. Also decide whether published generated stories should be text-deduped again: #1293 stopped that, relying on based_on links and recent_published_stories titles.
